Calculate Spatial Allocation Weights Matrix

Source: R/weights.R
calc_allocation_weights.Rd

Combines pairwise spatial distances, sink population counts, and distance decay kernels into an allocation weights matrix mapping sources to sinks.

Usage

calc_allocation_weights(
  dist_matrix,
  sink_pop = NULL,
  kernel_options = imuMAP::kernel_options("gravity"),
  normalize = TRUE,
  sparse = TRUE
)

Arguments

dist_matrix

An imumap_dist_matrix object created by calc_distance_matrix().

sink_pop

Optional data.frame or imumap_demographics object containing sink demographic population counts (must include id and population).

kernel_options

An imumap_kernel_options object, or a list of imumap_kernel_options objects. Defaults to kernel_options("gravity").

normalize

Logical. If TRUE, normalizes weights so each source row sums to 1. Defaults to TRUE.

sparse

Logical. If TRUE, stores weights as a sparse dgCMatrix. Defaults to TRUE.

Value

An S3 object of class imumap_weights.

Examples

pts <- sf::st_sfc(sf::st_point(c(0, 0)), sf::st_point(c(1, 1)), crs = 3857)
src <- sf::st_sf(id = c("s1", "s2"), geometry = pts)
snk_pts <- sf::st_sfc(sf::st_point(c(0, 0.5)), sf::st_point(c(1, 1.5)), crs = 3857)
snk <- sf::st_sf(id = c("c1", "c2"), geometry = snk_pts)
dmat <- calc_distance_matrix(src, snk)
w <- calc_allocation_weights(dmat)
